conclusions.text: All 96,607 original cells are accounted for and genuinely source-relative qualified, including 95,239 land and 1,368 inland-water cells; no original holds. All 864 owners, complete source, physical, historical and aggregate context remain.

Five aggregate semantic decisions, parent-role questions, original whole-candidate/whole-source discrepancies, GSHHG licence wording conflict, contemporary legal/dry-land claims and final selected/current-owner-zero/emitted delivery remain open or pending.

limits: No selected ownership, cumulative ledger, emitted raster, regional certificate, deployment or accepted repair credit changes in this source-authority handoff.

Complete PHL ADM1, ADM2 and ADM3 contain 17, 87 and 1,647 actual features. The represented-year claim is 2020, source update January 2023, build July/December 2023. Consumed simplified products are preserved distinctly from advertised full product URLs. Product feature counts are completeness checks; incidental global screening counts are derived outcomes.

Five aggregates have 73 complete source members covering 777 original centres. Original selection combines overlap threshold and normalized parent-name matches, then unions whole prepared members without candidate clipping. All five semantic statuses remain open. Coordinate-space mismatches and original literal-zero coverage diagnostics grant no legal or whole-target clearance.

All 362 issue-bearing physical source results remain. Native support does not certify complete targets, inland-water semantics or present dry land. GSHHG retained data licence and README differ on LGPL version wording.

Foreign ownerless, country and ADM1 screens use complete products and exact original native centres. Zero contacts do not establish current sovereignty or regional completeness; uncovered reference centres remain unknown.
All 1,166 historical overlapping candidates and their original holds remain, including 93 without PHL tags. Complete historical reconstruction, not country filtering, determines overlap.

Complete prior SEA 318-component/122-family packet, separate prior nine gap candidates and separate 22-candidate/ten-family context remain. Old issue #1500 full-budget, unsafe extractor/writer and consumed-helper caveats remain; no legacy execution or whole-gap clearance is claimed.
The separate 34,102-cell / 701-owner physical-interpretation companion is retained and uncredited. Current accepted overlap must be rechecked at delivery; original author baseline overlap was zero.

Initial unclassed source evidence and failed diagnostic stderr are retained as superseded evidence. Final authority uses native-inputs-002 and qualified-native-inputs-001. Only 30 literal-empty positive water classes are removed; original scope, all 932 atoms, whole physical evidence and negative inputs are unchanged.

Actual package producer/accounting executions and fourteen actual writer refusal controls are reported. No whole application or hosted emitted consumer test is claimed. Stock budgets are cooperative per-phase allowances, not a hard process memory supervisor.
